run_playthrough: run a playthrough of a specified game with a given action sequence and optional seed
summarize_playthrough_lines: summarize a playthrough as a list of lines with game metadata and state details
replay_playthrough: replay a saved playthrough file and return the original and regenerated outputs for comparison
update_playthrough_path: update all playthrough files in a directory by regenerating them and overwriting changed ones
test_should_display_state_tracker: test the ShouldDisplayStateTracker class that determines which game states are interesting enough to display
